changelog: Marketable-limit fill bug, confirmed on live (session 6, order #1/trade #126): a resting Long limit at 6902.39 sat pending while the market traded 6591.5-6666, and once price rose through the limit, filled at the stale 6902.39 instead of anywhere near the market -- the old touch check (low <= limit) doesn't care how far below the limit the bar's own range actually was.

Fix 1: a Long limit at or above the current close (or a Short at or below it) is now rejected at placement -- 'A Long limit above the market fills immediately. Use Market.' Mirrored in the ticket's own disabled-reason. Also fixed a real UX regression this surfaced before release: switching the ticket's Market->Limit toggle used to leave the limit sitting exactly AT the market (always 'marketable' by construction) -- it now offsets to the correct side automatically.

Fix 2 (engine safety net): a limit order that becomes marketable AFTER placement (price gaps through it before the next bar opens) now fills at the better of the limit or that bar's own open -- min() for a Long, max() for a Short -- matching how a real exchange fills a marketable order at the best available price, not a stale number.

Fix 3 (fill-and-stop on the same bar): a position that fills mid-bar no longer has its stop/target checked against the bar's full range as if it had been open the whole time -- only a level that sits BEYOND the actual fill price in its own direction can be hit on that same bar. Revised once before release after catching a real flaw in the first version: a stop left on the WRONG SIDE of a gap-driven fill was being deferred to the next bar, where it could get 'hit' at its own stale price and record a GAIN instead of a loss. Corrected: a wrong-side stop now triggers immediately, on the fill bar, at the fill price itself -- R approximately 0 before fees, never a profit.

Audited on live (2026-10-02): every row the v3.22.3 data-repair migration touched was re-checked against the correct directional touch rule. Only #126, #130, #131 matched its scope; #130 and #131 give the same result either way (price moved continuously through the level); #126 was the only one that actually differed, and was already hand-corrected. Nothing else outstanding -- no follow-up repair needed.

backtest_engine.php self-test: 60 assertions (12 new -- fill price and same-bar-touch rules, both directions, including the exact wrong-side-stop scenario caught before release). New harness assertion (drive-v3223.mjs): the ticket shows the exact marketable-limit rejection and disables Place Trade.
release_notes: No schema change this release -- db_migrations is empty, deploy is Update Now + a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R), no backup or migrate.php step needed. Verified via backtest_engine.php's own self-test (60 assertions, all passing) and tools/ui-harness/drive-v3223.mjs (22 assertions, all passing) -- see CLAUDE.md's v3.22.4 section for the exact wrong-side-stop case that was caught and corrected during this release's own pre-release review, before it ever shipped. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file. The risk-ladder engine, previously slated as v3.22.4, is now v3.22.5.
